verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents OpenAI API compatibility, saying existing applications can switch by changing the API key and base URL, with 'just two code changes'. It also supports standard OpenAI request shapes such as `image_url`. The migration guide notes the model ID must change too, and no independent hands-on report confirms a drop-in OpenAI SDK swap. Missing for 10: confirmation that no change beyond base URL and key is needed (the model ID must also change), and independent or hands-on corroboration of using the OpenAI SDK against Cerebras.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point an existing OpenAI SDK client at the provider by changing only the base URL and API key

citations.quote: Existing applications can use Cerebras by changing the API key, base URL, and model ID.
OpenAI API compatibility lets developers build on Cerebras with just two code changes.
The standard OpenAI `image_url` content shape is supported.
